{{Quote|Wipe them out! Never again will the Republic fear the Sith Empire!|Empress Teta, ordering the destruction of Naga Sadow's armada|<ref name="Fall 5" />}}
'''Empress''' was a title for a sovereign leader with ultimate authority over her dominions. Empress [[Teta/Legends|Teta]] cared for her [[Empress Teta system/Legends|star system]] with the support of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] advisors, and she represented her people at the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Senate Hall]] and personally led their [[Koros fleet|fleet]] in the [[Unification Wars (Koros)|Unification Wars]] and the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Although [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was divided by warfare and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-led oppression for millennia, Empress [[Marasiah Fel]] was part of the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] that attempted to reconcile factions alongside the [[New Jedi Order]].

==History==
===Empress for a Republic===
====Unifying seven worlds====
{{Quote|My people, the battles are nearly over, the political strife at an end&mdash;''and peace is upon us!'' The seven worlds have united in a glorious alliance for greater prosperity and military strength.|Empress Teta, in a public plaza of Cinnagar|<ref name="Golden 1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 1]]</ref>}}
[[File:AarrbaTeta-TGAotS2.jpg|thumb|right|360px|Aarrba's audience with Empress Teta]]
Empress [[Teta/Legends|Teta]] led the seven [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]] as part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point prior, Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Fattum]]'s administration gave control of that [[Star system/Legends|star system]] to its aristocrats. Teta ruled from the [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Imperial Palace]] in [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]]. The Koros system was an important source of [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] ore, used in [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]] that colonized the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and expand the Republic, which was based at the [[Senate Hall]] on the Core World [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. With the backing of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] and her [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] advisor [[Memit Nadill]], the Empress waged the [[Unification Wars (Koros)|Unification Wars]] to cement her government's control over the Koros system's carbonite trade.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> She converted her ceremonial throne room into a military command center, focusing on [[Battle of Kirrek (Unification Wars)|battling]] the remaining [[Kirrek rebels|rebels]] of the planet [[Kirrek]] after they slaughtered fifty hostages in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] joined Nadill and the Empress, using [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] to help her [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and depress the rebels, though some were driven to desperation and destroyed the [[Daragon family|Daragons']] [[Shadow Runner|supply ship]].<ref name="Golden 0">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 0|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 0]]</ref>

Following the end of the Unification Wars, Empress Teta and her Jedi advisors attended various events such as pageants, parades, inspection tours, and diplomatic receptions while ordering war-crime trials, with the judiciary also holding amnesty hearings.<ref name="Fall 1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 1]]</ref> Meanwhile, the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]]&mdash;having lost their [[Parent/Legends|parents]] at the end of the war on Kirrek and been cared for by, but indebted to, [[Aarrba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]&mdash;took their parents' old [[Starbreaker 12|starship]] from [[Aarrba's Repair Dock]] on Cinnagar and left the Koros system. They fled from the pressure of the merchant lords of Cinnagar's commerce sector,<ref name="Fall 1" /> but Aarrba believed that the young Daragons had betrayed his kindess. The Hutt requested a personal audience with Empress Teta, explaining his situation and pleading for the Empress not to let word spread that he had extended credit. She promised to keep his secret and affirmed that Koros' unified worlds must follow her empire's laws. On the same [[Standard day/Legends|day]],<ref name="Golden 2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref> Odan-Urr told Nadill and the Empress that he had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of the fabled [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], formed of [[Exiles|exiled adversaries]] of the Jedi and the Republic.<ref name="Fall 1" /> Odan-Urr wanted to avoid another war, and he, Nadill, and Empress Teta later traveled to Coruscant to alert the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the potential threat; despite the Empress' [[Politics/Legends|political]] experience, the trio's concerns were dismissed by [[Senator/Legends|senators]] at a scheduled session of assembly, but the Empress promised to the Jedi that they had her backing<ref name="Golden Age 4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> and continued maintaining the [[Koros fleet]] for her worlds' defense.<ref name="Fall 1" />

====Ending the Golden Age of the Sith====
{{Quote|We've bought amnesty with our blood today! Empress Teta will be true to her word&hellip;this is our home from now on.|Llaban, ex-rebel leader of Kirrek after defeating the Sith|<ref name="Fall 5" />}}
[[File:Empress_Teta.jpg|thumb|left|330px|Empress Teta waged the Unification Wars and, unlike the rest of the Republic, heeded warnings of the Sith threat.]]
At the end of their hyperspace journey, Gav and Jori Daragon stumbled upon the Sith Empire.<ref name="Fall 1" /> The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] had grown in power among an isolated [[Sith Worlds/Legends|cluster of worlds]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> Amidst a divided [[Sith Council]] over whether to use the [[Daragon Trail]] to expand into the Republic, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow]] stoked fears that the Daragon siblings were Republic [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and gathered sufficient support to become the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. Sadow then separated the Daragons, sending Jori back to the Koros system with a [[Tracking device (Sith Empire)|tracker]]<ref name="Golden Age 4" /> while persuading Gav that the Republic was an "oppressive system" and he could return home as a hero to help his sister rather than as a destitute debtor, paving way for the Sith Empire to invade the Republic in what would be known as the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="Fall 1" />

Back in Cinnagar, Jori worried about the threat of the Sith and intended to warn Empress Teta, but she was deemed mad by the authorities arresting her for previous criminal violations upon arrival.<ref name="Fall 1" /> As Jori was sent to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] colony world [[Ronika/Legends|Ronika]], she wondered if the courts were eager to sentence war criminals to colony planets only to increase the number of cheap workers, but she kept faith in the Empress, believing that she would personally believe her tale. Jori soon made her escape back to Cinnagar again, sneaking into the Empress Teta's throne room and pleading to the Empress herself about the threat of the Sith Empire. With the Jedi's fear confirmed, Empress Teta was confident that her unified forces could defend the [[Koros sector/Legends|Koros sector]] but worried that the rest of the Republic was unprepared.<ref name="Fall 2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 2]]</ref>

[[File:Teta_Korriban.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Empress Teta personally commanded her fleet within the Sith Empire, defeating the Dark Lord Naga Sadow.]]
Indeed, Empress Teta and her court analyzed the Sith Empire's attacks across the Republic, with surprised Jedi on Coruscant trying to defend the Senate Hall. The Empress accepted Kirrek rebel leader [[Llaban]]'s pleas for amnesty should his people join her forces against the Sith, and she further called on the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners of war]] in exile on the colony worlds to help the Republic in return for amnesty after the war.<ref name="Fall 3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 3]]</ref> When the Sith [[Battle of Kirrek (Great Hyperspace War)|attacked]] Kirrek, Llaban's rebels held strong with the help of Odan-Urr and the sacrifice of his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Ooroo/Legends|Ooroo]]. Additionally, the Empress, true to her word, sent prisoners from Ronika as reinforcements to Kirrek, gaining the rebels' trust.<ref name="Fall 5" />

When Gav Daragon realized the destructiveness of the Sith, he hunted for Naga Sadow while Jori, Empress Teta, and her fleet followed him&mdash;to [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]], where the Dark Lord left Gav to die, but not before the latter announced that the Sith Empire had been left largely undefended. The Empress and her fleet thus pursued Sadow and his [[Sith invasion fleet|surviving ships]] into the Sith Empire, [[Second battle of Korriban|defeating]] the armada at [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and the [[Denarii Nova]], where Sadow took advantage of the chaos of the exploding nova to flee. Regretting the "terrible cost" to Koros' fleet, Empress Teta declared her triumph and returned to Cinnagar, where reconstruction efforts began in earnest, as with elsewhere in the Republic. The Empress later helped Jori fulfill her wish of taking charge of Aarrba's Repair Dock.<ref name="Fall 5" /> The Koros system was eventually renamed the "Empress Teta system" in honor of its ruler, and Koros Major was likewise renamed "Empress Teta."<ref name="TEA" />

===Wars of the Old Republic===
{{Quote|Zakuul! My empire! The Alliance tried to destroy me, but I ground them to dust. Now the Outlander hides in fear, as my fleet rips through the galaxy. I am the wrath of the dragon's fire. I am your Eternal Empress!|Empress Vaylin, at her [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin|Grand Festival]]|<ref name="Chapter 6">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=6}}</ref>}}
While Naga Sadow had fled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Supreme Chancellor [[Pultimo]] of the Republic ordered a [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|counterinvasion]] of the Sith Worlds to dismantle the Sith Empire's institutions. The Sith Lord [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] secretly gathered the strongest of the Sith and oversaw the building of a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] over a thousand years, sustaining himself on his constant quest for [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]].<ref name="TEA" /> Empress Teta's [[Tetan monarchy/Legends|heirs]], [[Queen Mother]] [[Magda Keto]] and her brother Lord [[Keto]], continued ruling the Empress Teta system by working with the carbonite [[Mining/Legends|mining]] corporate interests. They neglected their children, [[Aleema Keto|Aleema]] and [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]], and were [[Political uprising of the Empress Teta system|overthrown]] by them in the Sith-inspired [[Krath Holy Crusade]], which led to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] against the Republic in [[3996 BBY]]. The Republic endured subsequent wars [[Mandalorian Wars|against Mandalorians]] and [[Jedi Civil War|among Jedi]] in a cycle of betrayals until [[Meetra Surik]], the Exiled Jedi with her [[Lost Jedi]] followers, destroyed the last of the Sith ideologies and suffering on [[Malachor V]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

[[File:Vaylin_5.png|thumb|left|350px|Empress Vaylin took power with SCORPIO by her side]]
However, the "true," direct lineage of Sith secretly cultivated by the Sith Emperor since the Great Hyperspace War took advantage of the oblivious Republic. The new Sith Empire waged the [[Great Galactic War]] but resulted in stalemate&mdash;the Sith Emperor, his foresight and fate tied to his Jedi hostage [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], seemingly disappeared, though he [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|regathered]] his strength on Yavin 4. In [[3636 BBY]], he mobilized his so-called [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] to [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquer]] both the Sith Empire and the Republic, forcing their remnant forces into disarray. While the Eternal Emperor was busy confronting the [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]], his children battled for the [[Eternal Throne]] and [[Arcann]] became Emperor. In the chaos, the [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|advanced artificial intelligence]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[SCORPIO]] outmaneuvered the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] in taking the throne to give the [[GEMINI]] droid captains of the [[Eternal Fleet]] free will. SCORPIO then decided to be an advisor to the daughter, [[Vaylin]], allowing her to rule as the Eternal Empress.<ref name="Chapter 16">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=16}}</ref> Sadistic and derisory, Vaylin directed her Empire's forces to fight the Outlander's new [[Eternal Alliance]], and during the [[War against Zakuul|war]], [[Darth Acina]] declared herself Empress of the Sith Empire.<ref name="The Eternal Throne" /> Vaylin's hatred for her father contributed to his eventual final destruction by the Alliance Commander.<ref name="Echoes">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Echoes of Oblivion|Kira Carsen's ship}}</ref> After the Eternal Empire's collapse, both the Republic and the Sith Empire attempted to reconsolidate their forces during the [[War on Iokath]], where Empress Acina met her demise and was succeeded by [[Darth Vowrawn]] as Emperor of the Sith.<ref name="Showdown">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Showdown on Iokath|Iokath}}</ref>

Eventually, the Sith were [[New Sith Wars|defeated]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and the Galactic Republic enjoyed one thousand years of relative peace until decades of oppression and warfare with the rise of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="NEC" /> Before the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was wiped out at the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|end]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Empress [[Sephani]] of [[Simocadia]] sought help from her Jedi Master friend [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to [[Battle of Simocadia|subdue]] the [[Ardana Shadex|stone giant]] awakened by her son, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Yojan]].<ref name="Colossus">''[[The Clone Wars: The Colossus of Destiny]]''</ref> A Sith Lord, Palpatine's regime was partly inspired by the successful [[Atrisian Empire]].<ref name="IS">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] prior, [[Oeana Tching]], known as the Invisible Empress, mastered the ''[[Sayings]]'' of the fifty-forth [[Atrisian Emperor/Legends|Atrisian Emperor]], [[Uueg Tching]],<ref name="CA Files">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref> who unified his planet 3000 years before Palpatine's time.<ref name="IS" /> Long before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], two [[Forest/Legends|forested]] planets in the [[Regency Worlds/Legends|Arkanis Regency]] were called "[[Teeda's Eyes]]" after the [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of Empress [[Teeda]].<ref name="Greel">{{JournalCite|6|The Greel Wood Haven}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the Empire, Emperor [[Alor Keto]] had been ruling Empress Teta as a weak puppet of the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] while his neice and rightful heir to the Tetan throne, [[Eara Lota]], protested the poor working conditions of [[Miner/Legends|miners]] in her star system and living conditions of prisoners on Ronika.<ref name="NOP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> After Emperor Palpatine was killed in [[Battle of Endor/Legends|battle]] against the Rebellion and its forming of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on the galactic capital of Coruscant, the Empire [[Imperial Civil War|splintered]] into warring factions.<ref name="NEC" /> The [[Priamsta]] [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] of [[Eiattu 6]] requested the rebel [[Isplourrdacartha Estillo]], the surviving member of the royal family that the aristocrats ousted in a bid to deal directly with the Empire, to return to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] as the [[Princess of the Realm|Empress Apparent-Heir and Princess of the Realm]]. She served as a unity figure given the threat of [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] and the local [[People's Liberation Battalion]].<ref name="RS13">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 13|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 13]]</ref>

===New empires and alliances===
[[File:MarasiahFel.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Marasiah Fel, the Empress who defeated the Sith]]
Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Betl Oxtroe]] later attempted to negotiate for the Empire's continuation by presenting Palpatine's eleven-year-old great-niece, [[Ederlathh Pallopides/Legends|Ederlathh Pallopides]], to the [[New Republic Provisional Council]] and proposing that the Empire to be reformed as a constitutional monarchy, with "Empress" Pallopides as a figurehead and the New Republic's leadership acting as [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisors]].<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] warfare nevertheless dragged on, and when [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Ysanne Isard]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] claimed succession to the notional Imperial throne, she pitted [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] and the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] against each other, planning to rule as Empress herself. However, Isard and the Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] failed to maim efforts toward [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]]. Admirals [[Natasi Daala]] and [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] [[Imperial Reunification|reunified]] the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|made peace]] with the New Republic, which transformed into the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="NEC" />

After Daala was elected as the Galactic Alliance's [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]], she consolidated government power over the [[New Jedi Order]], prompting rebel veterans in opposition to derisively nicknamed her "Empress Palpatina."<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref> Clear-sighted leaders of the Jedi, the Galactic Alliance, and the [[Fel Empire|Imperial Remnant]] of [[Jagged Fel]] united to destroy the self-styled "Beloved Queen of the Stars," [[Abeloth]], during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]] in [[44 ABY]]. The galaxy remained at relative peace between the Galactic Alliance and the Empire until [[127 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> with the overthrow of Empress [[Elliah Fel|Elliah]] and Emperor [[Roan Fel]] by [[Darth Krayt]] and the [[One Sith]].<ref name="War 2">[[Legacy — War 2|''Legacy — War'' 2]]</ref> The renewed Sith conquests were countered by a [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] formed of Galactic Alliance remnants, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]]'s Imperials, and the New Jedi Order that reunited the galaxy. Empress Marasiah Fel later commissioned a [[G51 communications array|communications project]] to further improve connections with the Outer Rim Territories.<ref name="Legacy 2013 1" />
